description: Explicit reviewed-commit attestations for reconcile_presynced_submodule.py. Each entry records the exact reviewed blob (sha256 + git mode) for a projected path, scoped to one old_sub -> new_sub gitlink pair. The push-triggered reconcile passes only entries matching the current pair to the VM, and the VM converges a mismatched live file only when its bytes AND mode match the recorded blob exactly. An entry exists only because a squash merge dropped the reviewed commit from main history, so git rev-list old_sub..new_sub cannot see it. Additions here are reviewed through protected main like any other control-plane change.
